童心"Good. Then the council continues."
Chachamaru"Arre, now I understand the old man's suffering. How did he even manage this lot, yaar? Only after a person is gone do you find out his real worth."
Chachamaru"Overwhelmed by remembrance, Chachamaru Ashikaga gave herself over to passionate castella-eating. Aansuon ki jagah cake—her substitute for tears."
Raichou"Do not substitute castella for tears..."
童心"...Now. Of course His Highness's funeral is important. The honor of the whole Rokuhara house depends on it."
獅子吼"I do not deny that, but—"
Raichou"Hmph! Silence, parvenu. As expected of Reverend Doushin: unlike this animal, you understand how things should be."
童心"Now, now, Raichou. Kindly hear me to the end."
童心"...The funeral is important, no doubt. But even among important things, some weigh heavy and some light. Call it a question of sequence, if you like."
Raichou"Sequence?"
童心"Think. If, in the present conditions, we held a state funeral needing immense expense and manpower, then what?"
童心"Unfortunately, the ground under the shogunate is shaking. And that our great enemy GHQ, and the anti-shogunate men hiding across the country, are watching that shaking like hungry tigers, there is no doubt at all."
Raichou"But even so...!"
童心"Of course, of course. I understand your grief, Raichou. For a child to postpone the father's rites, how it must feel, as if there is no ground to stand on! Yet if we truly think of peace for His Highness's spirit..."
童心"Should we not first tighten the hoopsbands that have gone loose on the shogunate, and rebuild the government under Kuniuji? Only then will His Highness rest easy beneath the grass. What say you?"
Raichou"..."
童心"For now, move the Court, and hurry the proclamation naming Kuniuji Lord General. Then, in the name of the new Lord General, we can hold the state funeral."
Chachamaru"Haan. No objection."
獅子吼"That is the obvious course. Anyone who is not an idiot would reach it."
Raichou"Ngh..."
童心"Raichou."
Raichou"...I... have no objection. Certainly... that would be safer."
Raichou"I seem to have been a little hasty. ...Forgive me, Reverend Doushin."
童心"No, no. Any dutiful child naturally wishes to mourn his father without delay. It is this monk who should be ashamed, obstructing filial devotion with political calculation."
Raichou"No..."
Chachamaru"Bad luck, Hideyoshi. Leave Daitokuji for next time. Nobunaga and Hidekatsu are not going anywhere."
Raichou"!! I-I have no idea what you are talking about."
獅子吼"...Hmph."
